1078.220:
The Deep Labyrinth goes down to Floor B24.
A Gatekeeper awaits every 8 floors.\c
Pick a door on each floor to go down,
and pick one reward when you win.\c
In the Tower, you use a rental team.
Your original party returns afterward.\c
You won’t heal on your own.
Survive with rewards and rest stops.\c
In battle, you can only use the
Tower Medicine the Tower gives you.\c
Using any other item is against the rules.
That floor won’t count, and the run ends.\c
At the start of each chapter, the path you
pick at the fork changes your opponents.\c
Clear Floor B24 on your highest Rank
to unlock the next Rank.\c
Higher Ranks are harsher,
but give more BP at the end.\c
After Floor B24, you can keep going
deeper into the Endless Depths.\c
If you lose, your items and Pokémon
stay as they were. Deeper means more BP.\c
Relics come in four types: Recovery,
Growth, Strategy, and Curse.\c
Collect three Relics of the same type
(Recovery, Growth, or Strategy) for a set bonus.\c
Curse Relics have both upsides
and downsides.\c
The Infinity Stone is turned off
in the Tower.\c
Beat a battle floor to earn Tower Coins.
Spend in shops, or swap for BP at the end.\c
You never know what’s behind
a ? Door.\c
Beating an Elite refills your ★Labyrinth
Mushrooms up to one.\c
You can only Dynamax in the Labyrinth,
and shop-bought ★Max Mushrooms do nothing.
